title: Class rename — only role + visible text survive (no testid)
story: The cart link kept its role and text but lost its old class. With no data-testid the best anchor is getByRole + accessible name. Confidence lands ~0.49, so this scenario uses a tuned threshold (see README on the MAX_SCORE normalization).
